action_execution.0: Reuse completed validated local MC result; no second local inference
action_execution.1: Send exactly 10 normalized features-v1 values; full-cloud model through MQTT

features.name: state.uncertainty.confidence
features.runtime_source: inference::UncertaintyResult.confidence after the existing five-pass local MC result
features.training_provenance: measured M30; carried unchanged in replay

features.name: state.uncertainty.entropy
features.runtime_source: inference::UncertaintyResult.predictiveEntropyNats after the existing five-pass local MC result
features.training_provenance: measured M30; carried unchanged in replay

features.name: state.uncertainty.margin
features.runtime_source: Largest minus second-largest UncertaintyResult.meanProbabilities; existing matched campaign calculation
features.training_provenance: measured M30; carried unchanged in replay

features.name: state.device.free_heap
features.runtime_source: ESP.getFreeHeap() after local inference and before selection; existing matched campaign snapshot
features.training_provenance: measured M30; carried unchanged in replay, not remeasured

features.name: state.device.inference_latency_estimate
features.runtime_source: micros() difference around existing runPrefixB3 + runStochasticUncertaintyFromEmbedding, divided by 1000; matched harness state_us
features.training_provenance: measured M30; scaled and/or queue-adjusted in simulated replay

features.name: state.network.mqtt_rtt_ms
features.runtime_source: Correlated application MQTT probe elapsed micros()/1000; existing matched harness exchange(); must be integrated before production decision
features.training_provenance: measured M30 application probe; transformed by simulated profiles

normalization.algorithm: (raw - offset) / divisor in declared feature order; float32 deployment
normalization.calibration: Fixed unit scaling: probabilities unchanged, entropy / ln(5), heap / 1024 KiB, time / existing M30 100 ms reward reference; no fitted data statistics

grouping.algorithm: SHA256 canonical JSON of original feature window identity; run/profile/repeat not part of group
grouping.partition: sort group SHA256(seed + group_key); first ceil(0.25 * groups) holdout; remaining train
grouping.limitation: Within-session window-group holdout only; no independent-session claim

excluded_features.local_compute_pressure: synthetic-only replay input; no production source
excluded_features.inference_queue_pressure: synthetic-only replay input; no production queue monitor
excluded_features.cloud_availability: simulated in v3; production availability check not established
excluded_features.rssi_dbm: sidecar only; not projected into versioned decision state
excluded_features.tensor_arena_usage: constant B3-specific resource metric; not selected
excluded_features.cpu_frequency: constant in accepted campaign; not selected
excluded_features.predicted_class: not selected; uncertainty describes the local prediction
excluded_features.connection_state: constant connected in eligible source; record retained, not selected
